 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay

sentences.text: CRIMINAL APPELLATE JURISDICTION  CRIMINAL APPLICATION NO. 396 OF 2026
Tanaji Nathu Khopade ...Applicant
Versus  The State of Maharashtra ...
Respondent
_ _  Mr. Tuushar Sonawane, learned Advocate for the Applicant.
Mr. Tanveer G. Khan, learned A.P.P. for the State/Respondent.
_ _  CORAM : ASHWIN D. BHOBE, J.
DATE : 6th MARCH 2026.

P.C. :
1. Heard Mr. Tuushar Sonawane, learned Advocate for the Applicant and Mr. Tanveer Khan, learned A.P.P. for the State/Respondent.
2.

By the present Criminal Application, the Applicant is seeking to quash First Information Report bearing No. 567 of 2025 dated 31.07.2025 for the offences punishable under Sections 223, 123, 274, 275 & 3(5) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita,
2023 along with Sections 59, 37, 27(3)(c), 26(2)(iv) & 26(2) of the Food Safety &
Standards Act, 2006 registered with MIDC Police Station, Mumbai.
3. Mr. Tuushar Sonawane, learned Advocate for the Applicant submits that the issue involved in the present Criminal Application is pending for consideration before the Hon'ble Supreme Court.
He further submits that similar issues are involved in Criminal Writ Gitalaxmi 4-APL-396-2026.doc Petition Nos. 280 of 2025, 3444 of 2025 and 4078 of 2025.

entities.text: Petition Nos. 280 of 2025, 3444 of 2025 and 4078 of 2025
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text:
He refers to the orders passed in the above said Petitions,
wherein this Court has admitted the same and granted interim reliefs.

4. Mr. Tanveer Khan, learned A.P.P. for the State/Respondent does not dispute that the issue involved in the present Criminal Application is subject matter of the Tanaji Nathu Khopade vs State Of Maharashtra on 6 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/63022871/
1 Petitions, referred by the Applicant in the present Criminal Application.

entities.text: Tanaji Nathu Khopade vs State Of Maharashtra
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He submits that the present Criminal Application filed under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (for short "BNSS") be tagged along with the aforesaid Petitions.
5. Mr. Tuushar Sonawane, learned Advocate for the Applicant submits that the interim orders granted in the aforesaid Petitions, be also granted in this Criminal Application.
6. Mr. Tanveer Khan, learned A.P.P. for the State/Respondent does not object to the said request.
7. In view of the above, further proceedings arising out of Crime No. 567 of 2025 dated 31.07.2025 registered with MIDC Police Station, Mumbai, are stayed qua the Applicant.

8. Tag the present Criminal Application along with Criminal Writ Petition Nos. 280 of 2025, 3444 of 2025 and 4078 of 2025.
[ASHWIN D. BHOBE, J.] GITALAXMI KRISHNA KRISHNA KOTAWADEKAR KOTAWADEKAR Date:
